summary.intent: Run a code review and cleanup (simplify) pass on phase 22 changes — performance baselines instrumentation, Playwright E2E journey timing, and load test thresholds — then commit and open a PR.
summary.outcome: Six issues were fixed (PerformanceMeasure leak, threshold assertion boilerplate extracted, unused field/import removed, account scope narrowed, unpinFromIpfs instrumented), all tests pass, and the cleanup was committed across 10 files.

repo: Phases can be executed out of order — phases 22 and 23 were completed before 21, which is still actively in progress.
The roadmap tracks completion with [x] markers and absolute dates (e.g., 2026-03-24); the `phase complete` tool's `next_phase` field can be misleading when phases complete out of order.
The GSD workflow uses background executor agents that emit task-notification messages; stale notifications from prior phases can appear in later sessions and should be ignored.
Load test scenarios previously duplicated an 8-line threshold assertion block verbatim across all 5 scenario files — now consolidated via `expectThresholdsPassed()` in thresholds.ts.
Performance marks use the browser Performance API; `withPerf` wraps functions and calls `markEnd` in a finally block but did not previously expose the measure return value.

code.finding: Added `performance.clearMeasures()` after creating a measure to prevent unbounded accumulation in long-running sessions.
Test previously verified measures via `getEntriesByType` — after adding clearMeasures(), the test was updated to verify via the measure return value / spy instead.
New `expectThresholdsPassed()` helper extracted here; all 5 scenario files now import and call it instead of inlining the assertion block.
Removed unused `partial` field from `JourneyResult` interface, narrowed `account` from describe-level `let` to `const` inside the test, and removed unused `PrivateKeyAccount` import.
`unpinFromIpfs` was the only IPFS function not wrapped with `withPerf`; added `withPerf('ipfs:unpin', ...)` for consistency with `addToIpfs` and `fetchFromIpfs`.

workflow: When `expect` is removed from test logic (replaced by a helper), its vitest import becomes unused and should be cleaned up — easy to miss without a lint pass.
Passing large diffs (73KB) to review agents via file path rather than inline content avoids context bloat.
Running three parallel review agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) then aggregating findings before making edits is an efficient review pattern.

friction: The GSD `phase complete` tool returned `next_phase: 23` even though phase 23 was already marked complete in the roadmap, causing a misleading 'Next Up' prompt.
Stale background task notifications from prior executor agents surfaced in the current session, requiring manual triage.
The PerformanceMeasure leak fix broke an existing test that relied on entries persisting in `getEntriesByType`, requiring a follow-up test update.
open_items: Phase 21 is still actively in progress and needs to be completed.
Two human verification items remain for phase 22: (1) run journey tests against live services to populate baselines.json, (2) confirm Performance API marks appear in browser DevTools.
Stringly-typed `operation` field in perf instrumentation was flagged but intentionally skipped — silent skip on mismatch is by design but could be revisited.
PR creation was requested at the end of the session but the transcript ends before it was completed — PR still needs to be opened.
